scenes.text: At station 1, which direction is opposite to left? Let us think carefully. Opposites point in reverse directions. The answer is right. Great work!
At station 2, which direction is opposite to up? Let us think carefully. Opposites point in reverse directions. The answer is down. Great work!
At station 3, which direction is opposite to forward? Let us think carefully. Opposites point in reverse directions. The answer is backward. Great work!
At station 4, which direction is opposite to north? Let us think carefully. Opposites point in reverse directions. The answer is south. Great work!
